CSIRO Mouse Surveillance

Spring-2015 Seasonal Summary

Published

April 24, 2026

Overview

This report summarizes house mouse monitoring activities conducted during the Spring-2015 season across Australian grain-growing regions. Mouse abundance was assessed using three complementary survey methods: live-trapping at benchmark sites, and rapid assessments using chew cards and active burrow counts.

Live-trap Surveys: A total of 1,284 trap nights (1 trap night = 1 trap set for 1 night) were conducted across 16 benchmark sites in 3 regions spanning 3 states (survey period: October 2015 to October 2015). These surveys captured 28 individual house mice, allowing abundance estimates at these monitoring locations.

Rapid Assessment Surveys: Rapid assessments were conducted across 10 regions using two methods. Chew card surveys deployed 1,350 cards across 76 sites, with 3.7% showing evidence of mouse activity (50 cards chewed). Active burrow surveys searched 285 transects across 72 sites (survey period: October 2015 to October 2015), detecting active burrows in 3.5% of transects (total: 21 active burrows).
